questions.stem_text:
Stars are often classified by their apparent brightness in the nighttime sky. Stars can
also be classified in many other ways. Which of these is least useful in classifying
stars?
What is the primary cause of rainstorms?

options.A: Earth is heated by the Sun.
options.D: Most of Earth is covered with water.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Earth is heated by the Sun.

questions.stem_text:
A river erodes its banks for thousands of years, and deposits the eroded material at its
mouth. What two landforms did the river make?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - a delta and a canyon
